description: Runs the monitor as SYSTEM with no fakes: loopback (127.0.0.1) always replies and the documentation address 192.0.2.1 never does. Proves loopback is healthy, 192.0.2.1 alerts as down, one of each is healthy under Any and degraded under All, bad input is refused as 'Check could not run', and a second run is harmless. The WireGuard check is not covered: a runner has no tunnel or peer. Stopping it mid-run prints no result block, which no PowerShell monitor can prevent (see Killed monitors in the harness README).

steps.label: 192.0.2.1 never answers: alert
outputContains: STATUS=Connection down: 0 of 1 target replied (192.0.2.1 no

steps.label: Any (default): one reply out of two is healthy
All: one reply out of two is degraded
outputContains: STATUS=Connection degraded: 1 of 2 targets did not reply and all are required

steps.label: Nothing to check: check could not run
outputContains: STATUS=Check could not run: nothing to check

steps.label: Out-of-range ping count: check could not run
outputContains: STATUS=Check could not run: usrPingCount must be 1-10 (got '11')

steps.label: A target that is not an address: check could not run
outputContains: STATUS=Check could not run: usrTargets entry '127.0.0.1;whoami' is not an IP address or hostname

steps.label: Stopped mid-run (192.0.2.1, 10 pings): no result block at all, since a killed PowerShell process cannot print one
